name: Graduation
overview: Graduation marks a significant transition where believers are called to trust fully in the Lord rather than their own understanding, as Proverbs 3:5 encourages. God’s presence and strength are assured, with commands to be courageous and unafraid because He will never fail or forsake His people (Deuteronomy 31:6; Joshua 1:9). The Lord’s guidance is likened to a lamp lighting the path (Psalms 119:105), and His blessings and protection are promised (Numbers 6:24), enabling graduates to pursue their God-given plans with confidence and faith.
